reference_sampling: uniform without replacement global permutation, seed 247002, nested 16/64/256
triple_sampling: one uniform unordered neighbor pair per eligible center, seed 247001
disconnected_estimand: finite references in same component; no imputation; small components may have no references

four_node.sampling: v2: 500 centers; first 12 sorted neighbors; at most 10 triples per center; ID-biased, not population uniform
four_node.uncertainty: NA: selection has zero inclusion probability outside first12; no unbiased population estimate or confidence interval justified

orbit_scope: center orbit participation in sampled 3-node instances, not full exact orbit totals

graph_build_rules.source: results/stage0_build_parquet/train.parquet: one sequence per user = longest history plus its target
graph_build_rules.edges: adjacent transitions (i -> i+1) inside each user sequence; self-loops dropped
graph_build_rules.weight: number of users contributing the transition
graph_build_rules.visible_users: frozen v2 split (seed 246001, ratios 0.8/0.1/0.1): 45951/5744/5744, pairwise disjoint
graph_build_rules.undirected_projection: visible directed support symmetrised, unweighted, loop-free
graph_build_rules.curvature_inputs: visible graph only; struct_val/struct_test edges and full-description graph never read
graph_build_rules.ppr: not computed, not read, not referenced

ego: exact induced radius1/2 on demand from frozen visible CSR; sampled v2 separately retained
